name: Gable Sorn
source_profile: ● Gable Sorn (NE) is the manager of Ironmark's largest frontier lending office. He has developed a profitable reputation for extending credit to desperate miners and struggling merchants, often on terms that ultimately allow the company to seize their property. Sorn is also rumored to maintain private dealings with claim jumpers and unscrupulous land brokers.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 45 (source excerpt; may be partial)
